latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of Automatic Music Generator.
- Upload MP4, MOV, AVI, or WebM videos (up to 500MB) to generate AI-scored background music and export as 1080p MP4.
- Automatic onboarding with free anonymous token support for new users.
- Integrated cloud render pipeline with 30-90 second processing for video+music exports.
- Support for credits, session management, state preview, export, and status queries.
- Clear error handling, guided prompts, and action mapping for common video editing workflows.
